@base = http://127.0.0.1:18081

### Read a JSON response
GET {{base}}/echo
Accept: application/json

### Send a UTF-8 body
POST {{base}}/echo
Content-Type: application/json; charset=utf-8
X-Demo: open-goland

{"message":"你好，open Goland 😀"}

### Run this request, then click Stop
GET {{base}}/slow

### Inspect 302 without automatically following it
GET {{base}}/redirect
